eta.name: Lachen
eta.action: Move everyone uphill, away from the river, now.

eta.name: Chungthang · Teesta-III dam
eta.action: Open spillway gates, evacuate the powerhouse and dam crew.

eta.name: Dikchu
eta.action: Clear the riverbank and the bridge approach; move uphill.

eta.name: Singtam
eta.action: Close the Teesta bridge, clear riverside homes and the bazaar.

eta.name: Rangpo
eta.action: Close NH10 along the river, clear riverside settlements.

method.segmenter: NDWI > 0.2 and NIR < 0.15 on Sentinel-2 L2A; cloud labels kept only where SWIR > 0.10
method.drain: Sentinel-1 RTC VV, 5x5 median, Otsu threshold on the pre pass, alarm at 25% loss
method.flow: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, pysheds fill + resolve flats + D8
